settings.heading: Launch and grow in Australia
settings.text: Coolkidz takes international baby brands from first shipment to national presence: distribution, retail, marketing and your own Australian website, under one roof, for over 25 years.

settings.heading: Why brands choose Coolkidz
settings.text: Everything a baby brand needs to win in Australia, run by one team that already does it for twelve brands.

settings.title: National distribution
settings.text: A 7,000 sqm warehouse with stock management and fast dispatch to retailers and parents.

settings.title: An established retail network
settings.text: Independent baby stores, national chains and online retailers across Australia, with a sales team to support them.

settings.title: Your own Australian website
settings.text: We build and run a Shopify website for your brand, with Australian pricing, warranty registration and local support.

settings.title: A 12-person marketing team
settings.text: Launch campaigns, paid social and search, email, content, influencers and retail activations, localised for Australian families.

settings.title: Customer service and warranty
settings.text: Product questions, warranty claims and returns handled by our team, through one help desk for every brand.

settings.title: Face to face with parents
settings.text: Stands at baby expos in Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, Perth and Adelaide, where parents try before they buy.

settings.heading: How a launch works
settings.text: Every brand is different, but most launches follow the same five steps.

settings.title: Conversation
settings.text: Tell us about your brand, range and plans. We'll share how we'd position it in Australia.

settings.title: Range and pricing
settings.text: We agree the launch range and Australian pricing across retail, online and direct.

settings.title: Ready to land
settings.text: Product data, local labelling, warranty terms and support content, ready before stock arrives.

settings.title: Launch
settings.text: Your Australian website, retailer sell-in and launch campaign go live together.

settings.title: Grow
settings.text: Weekly reporting, new channels, events and range expansion as the brand builds.
